beardeddragon: A bearded dragon standing flat on all fours in side view, a broad flattened sandy-tan lizard. THE BEARD IS PART OF ITS THROAT, NOT AN OBJECT UNDER ITS CHIN: the loose skin beneath the jaw is puffed downward into a rounded pouch and the SCALES COVERING THAT POUCH ARE ENLARGED INTO SHORT DARK GREY POINTED SPINES, continuous with the head skin. Matching rows of pointed scales run along each flank and around the back of the skull. Long tapering tail.
beardedseal: A bearded seal lying flat and horizontal, a true seal with a small head on a very thick sausage body. Its whiskers are INDIVIDUAL SEPARATE LONG PALE HAIRS, perhaps twenty of them, springing from the sides of its muzzle and curling into loose spirals at the ends - a spray of distinct strands, not a solid mass and not a brush. Plain silvery-grey coat, large dark eyes, short front flippers flat at its sides.
bluemussel: A blue mussel seen at a slight angle so the shell reads as SOLID AND THREE-DIMENSIONAL, its two halves meeting along a visible seam. The shell is asymmetric: NARROW AND POINTED at the hinge end and BROADLY FANNED at the other, with a gently curved back edge and a straighter belly edge. Deep dull blue-black, matte, with fine concentric growth lines. A small bundle of fine golden-brown threads emerges near the pointed end.
blueshark: A blue shark in level side profile, a slender shark whose snout is a SHORT ROUNDED CONE no longer than the distance from its eye to its gills - a soft blunt point, never a spear, never a blade, never a long bill. Its body is moderately deep through the middle. Five gill slits, large dark round eyes, and EXTREMELY LONG NARROW CURVED PECTORAL FINS held out level. Indigo blue back, bright blue flanks, snow-white belly.
brownrat: A brown rat standing on all fours in side view, a LARGE ELONGATED rodent with a long low body, a blunt heavy snout, small thick rounded ears, and coarse shaggy grizzled brown fur that lies flat rather than fluffing out. Its tail is a THICK MUSCULAR ROPE, wide at the base and tapering, about as long as its body, held straight out behind. Large pink feet, small dark eyes.
bumblebeebat: A bumblebee bat, a bat SO SMALL IT WOULD SIT ON A THUMBNAIL, its whole body barely longer than the width of a finger. Its muzzle is SHORT AND TRUNCATED with a flattened fleshy pad at the end carrying two crescent-shaped nostrils. Large rounded ears with a slender pointed inner flap, tiny eyes, reddish-brown fur. Thin dark leathery wings folded closed at its sides with the long finger bones ridging the membrane.
collaredlemming: A collared lemming in winter, a small rodent whose body is a SMOOTH ROUNDED BALL OF LONG PURE WHITE FUR with no visible ears, no visible neck and no visible tail - the outline is almost a circle broken only by a blunt face and four small feet. Tiny black bead eyes and a tiny dark nose. On each FRONT paw the two middle claws are ENLARGED INTO THICK PALE FORKED DIGGING BLADES.
europeanmole: A European mole in strict side profile, LOW AND HORIZONTAL, its body a SMOOTH BLACK CYLINDER of dense velvety fur with no neck, no waist and no visible ears, tapering at the front into a SHORT CONICAL PINK SNOUT. Its enormous pink SPADE-SHAPED FRONT PAWS are set right beside the head at ground level, palms turned outward and edged with pale claws. Tiny hind feet and a short pink stub of tail.
hoodedseal: A hooded seal lying flat, silver-grey blotched with black. THE RED SAC IS A BALLOON OF NASAL LINING PUSHED OUT THROUGH ONE NOSTRIL AT THE FRONT OF THE MUZZLE, hanging forward and to one side of the snout at nose level, glossy scarlet and roughly the size of the seal's head. It hangs from the tip of the face, NOT from the top of the skull. Its mouth stays closed and its eyes are dark.
kangaroorat: A kangaroo rat sitting upright, and the PROPORTIONS are the point: its HIND LEGS ARE ENORMOUS, thick-thighed and far longer than the rest of its body, folded beneath it like a kangaroo's, while its FORELIMBS ARE TINY, barely more than small hands held at the chest. Big blunt head, enormous dark eyes, sandy-buff fur, white underside. Its tail is a long thin bare rod with a small flat tuft only at the tip.
littlemarianafruitbat: A little Marianas fruit bat sitting upright with its WINGS FOLDED CLOSED FLAT AGAINST ITS SIDES so the body outline shows. ITS HEAD IS A FOX'S HEAD: a long tapering muzzle, a black wet nose at the tip, a strong jaw, large round dark eyes set forward, and small simple pointed ears. Dense dark chocolate fur with a pale golden-brown mantle over the shoulders. Absolutely NOT a snub-faced cartoon bat.
loggerheadturtle: A loggerhead sea turtle swimming, its shell LOW, BROAD AND FLATTENED into a smooth streamlined heart shape, NOT domed and NOT a tortoise shell. Its front limbs are LONG FLAT PADDLE-SHAPED FLIPPERS held out like wings, far longer than the rear pair, with no toes. Its head is enormous and blocky with a heavy hooked beak, mouth closed. Reddish-brown shell, warm yellow-brown skin.
mountaingoat: A mountain goat standing in side view, heavy and thickset with a deep chest, a hump of muscle over the shoulders and short sturdy legs. ITS HORNS ARE VERY SHORT - no longer than its own ears - SLENDER, SMOOTH, JET BLACK AND ONLY SLIGHTLY CURVED BACKWARD, rising close together from the top of the skull. Thick shaggy white coat with long chaps over the legs, a white beard, black hooves and a black nose.
pistolshrimp: A pistol shrimp, and it is a SHRIMP not a lobster: a small slender semi-transparent body banded orange and white, with a smooth curved back, a thin fan tail, long fine antennae and small stalked eyes. ONE CLAW IS ENORMOUS AND OUT OF ALL PROPORTION, as big as the whole rest of the animal, blocky and squared with a thick pivoting hammer cocked open. THE OTHER CLAW IS TINY AND ORDINARY.
plainspocketgopher: A plains pocket gopher on all fours, a stout brown burrowing rodent with a broad flat head, tiny eyes and tiny ears. ITS TWO UPPER FRONT TEETH ARE PART OF ITS SKULL: broad flat orange-yellow chisels growing straight out from the upper jaw and projecting forward beyond the closed lips, short and square-ended. They are teeth in its face, not sticks in its mouth. Heavy pale digging claws, fur-lined cheek pouches, short bare tail.
portuguesemanowar: A Portuguese man o' war. Its float is a SOFT TRANSLUCENT GAS-FILLED BLADDER OF LIVING TISSUE, glassy and iridescent, shading from pale blue through violet to rose pink, its surface smooth and slightly wet-looking - NOT striped, NOT rigid, NOT a balloon or an airship. A thin ruffled crest rises along the top. Beneath one end hangs a dense untidy bundle of fine bright blue tentacles of wildly unequal length.
remora: A remora in side profile, a slim dark grey fish. On top of its head sits a LARGE FLAT OVAL DISC occupying the whole skull roof from snout to behind the eyes, its surface crossed by MANY CLOSELY SPACED PARALLEL RIDGES running side to side like the slats of a shutter, with a raised rim around the outside. The disc is flush with the head and made of the same skin. Lower jaw juts forward, small forked tail.
sargassumfrogfish: A sargassum frogfish with its MOUTH FIRMLY CLOSED IN A SMALL DOWNTURNED SLIT, showing no teeth at all. A small rounded fish whose entire body and fins are broken up by ragged fleshy tassels and weed-like flaps of skin growing out in every direction, mottled olive, gold and cream with dark scribbled lines. Its front fins are arm-like with an elbow-like joint and splayed finger-like rays. Small round eyes.
sootyshearwater: A sooty shearwater gliding, seen from below at a slight angle so ITS BODY, HEAD AND TAIL ARE ALL CLEARLY VISIBLE and it does not read as a bare cross. A slender dark chocolate-brown seabird with a plump body, a long slim dark hooked bill with raised tubular nostrils, long narrow stiff wings held out and slightly bowed, and a short rounded tail. A broad silvery-pale flash runs along the centre of each underwing.
woollyflyingsquirrel: A woolly flying squirrel with its limbs stretched sideways so the gliding membrane is open. THE MEMBRANE IS COVERED IN THE SAME DENSE WOOLLY GREY-BROWN FUR AS THE REST OF THE ANIMAL - a furred blanket of skin, never bare, never pink and never leathery like a bat's. It is a very large squirrel the size of a domestic cat, with very large dark eyes, small rounded ears, and a long thick heavily furred tail.
mutt: A mixed-breed dog of no recognisable breed standing in side view, a plain medium dog of moderate build with a medium-length tapered muzzle, one ear flopping and the other half-standing, and a short coarse coat in an uneven muddy mix of tan and grey-brown with a few scruffy off-white patches placed asymmetrically. A shelter mongrel, absolutely NOT a collie, NOT a shepherd and NOT any pedigree breed.
anatolianshepherd: An Anatolian shepherd standing in side view, a VERY LARGE and HEAVY-BONED livestock guardian: thick neck, broad deep chest, massive shoulders and thick straight legs with big feet, built like a mastiff rather than a lean running dog. Short dense pale sandy-fawn coat, a SOOTY BLACK MASK over the muzzle and around the eyes, small dark drop ears, and a long thick tail carried low in a loose curve.
angorarabbit: An Angora rabbit, a rabbit buried in an enormous mass of long silky PURE WHITE wool that hangs past its feet and swallows its outline into a single round cloud - THE WOOL IS WHITE ALL OVER INCLUDING THE FACE AND EARS. A small pink nose, two dark round eyes and long white whiskers show through the fringe, and its upright ears are white with long trailing tufts at the tips.
bredaxolotl: A leucistic axolotl in side view, a slender aquatic salamander with a LONG LOW BODY and a BROAD FLAT WIDE HEAD much wider than its neck, a wide straight mouth, and small lidless dark eyes set far apart on top. Smooth translucent pinkish-white skin. THREE PAIRS OF SLENDER GILL STALKS project sideways from behind the head, each fringed with fine blood-red filaments. Four small delicate legs, a long finned tail.
domesticfox: A domesticated silver fox sitting, and it is a FOX not a dog: a slender pointed muzzle, a narrow face, large upright triangular ears and a very long thick brush of a tail. Its coat is dark silver-grey broken by IRREGULAR WHITE PIEBALD PATCHES over the face, chest and paws, and ONE EAR FLOPS OVER SOFTLY AT THE TIP while the other stands upright. Its tail curls up over its back.
englishbudgie: An English show budgerigar in side view, a budgie much larger and heavier than a wild one, with a broad deep chest. The feathers of its forehead and crown are LONG AND DENSE AND SWEEP BACKWARD IN ONE CONTINUOUS PIECE WITH THE REST OF ITS PLUMAGE, swelling the skull into a high smooth dome that overhangs and partly hoods the eyes. Sky-blue body, white face, fine black barring across the wings.
fancypigeon: A fantail pigeon standing, a small PURE WHITE pigeon with an erect rounded chest thrust high and its head tipped back. ITS TAIL IS HELD VERTICALLY, spread into a broad ROUNDED WHITE FAN standing straight up behind it like an open shell, made of thirty or more short stiff white feathers of even length. All white, with a small pale bill and short feathered legs.
frenchbulldog: A French bulldog standing square and facing forward, a SMALL COMPACT dog with a broad chest, short thick legs and a short smooth FAWN coat. Its head is large and square with a very flat short muzzle, a deep wrinkle across the nose and round dark eyes set wide and low. Its EARS ARE LARGE, UPRIGHT AND BROAD AT THE BASE with a clean ROUNDED TOP, set high and wide apart. Short stumpy tail.
munchkin: A Munchkin cat standing in strict side view, and the PROPORTIONS are the whole point: it has the head, body and tail of a normal adult cat, but ITS LEGS ARE ONLY ABOUT HALF THE NORMAL LENGTH, so its chest and belly hang very close to the ground and the body looks long and low, like a cat on a dachshund's legs. The legs are short but straight and evenly proportioned. Medium tabby coat, upright ears, long tail.
burmese: A Burmese cat sitting in side view, a compact heavy medium cat with a rounded skull, full cheeks and a short straight muzzle with a firm chin. Its coat is very short, close-lying and satin-glossy in a warm even SABLE BROWN, darkening slightly on the face and ears, and its eyes are large, round and deep golden-yellow. Its tail is straight and tapering.
xmasislandpipistrelle: A Christmas Island pipistrelle, a TINY bat with a body no longer than a thumb, covered in dense soft dark chocolate-brown fur. It has small rounded ears with a short blunt inner flap, tiny black eyes, and a short blunt muzzle. Its thin dark leathery wings are folded closed against its sides with the long finger bones showing as fine ridges through the membrane. It sits upright on small clawed feet.
hornbill: A southern ground hornbill standing on long dark legs, a large turkey-sized bird with ENTIRELY SOOTY BLACK plumage. Its face and throat carry BARE WRINKLED SKIN OF BRILLIANT SCARLET RED, forming a bare red mask around the pale eye and a loose folded red wattle hanging beneath the chin. Its bill is heavy, black and gently downcurved, with a short low casque ridge along the top of the upper mandible.
